annotation_method: Boundaries drafted with an AI tool from the video frames (version 2), then checked against the video and approved by Mostafa Taha and Osama Najjar; no boundaries changed.
draft_method: Drafted with an AI tool from the video frames only (version 2): a 1 s contact sheet over the whole clip, at the granularity of docs/ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md section 1 (a new step when the hands release one item and reach for another, when the manipulation changes kind, or when a tool is picked up or put down). Version 1 boundaries were kept; boundaries at hard edit cuts were snapped to the cut frame. The system's predictions were never consulted.
duration_note: Decodable length. The container metadata reports a few seconds more, but no frames decode past this point (features.csv ends here too).

steps.label: Take a fan out of its box
Cut open the next fan box
Pick up the next fan box
Place the fans on the bracket
Align the fans on the bracket
Screw the fans to the bracket
